findings.current: His body, hidden behind a mask while he secretly served as an East Depot eunuch just like his Master’s, had never been found. That could only mean one thing.
findings.defect: The draft makes the body seem hidden behind a mask; Ma Sanbao wore the mask while operating in secret.
findings.rationale: 가면을 쓴 채 describes Ma Sanbao’s conduct before his disappearance, not the location or condition of his body.
findings.replacement: Like his Master, he’d worn a mask while working in secret as an East Depot eunuch. His body had never been found, and that could only mean one thing.
findings.source: 자신의 스승처럼 가면을 쓴 채 동창의 태감으로 암약하던 그의 시체는 끝끝내 찾을 수 없었고, 이는 한 가지 사실만을 의미했다.

findings.current: I’d crossed paths with Hak Woo, the Kunlun Sect’s greatest young prodigy and a member of the Ten Dragons and Phoenixes, during the Star-Array Grand Banquet.
findings.defect: Hak Woo’s stated epithet is omitted.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly identifies him as 곤륜운룡.
findings.replacement: I’d crossed paths with Hak Woo—the Kunlun Cloud Dragon, the Kunlun Sect’s greatest young prodigy and a member of the Ten Dragons and Phoenixes—during the Star-Array Grand Banquet.
findings.source: 성라대연 당시 곤륜파 최고의 후기지수이자 십봉룡의 일원이던 곤륜운룡(崑崙雲龍) 학우와 인연을 맺기는 했지만

findings.current: Starting a campfire in the middle of enemy territory was enough to set off every last one of my nerves. But one lunatic didn’t seem to mind.
findings.defect: The reaction is narrowed to the narrator and softens 개소리; the source says this infuriates the others as well.
findings.rationale: 나를 포함한 다른 이들 includes the narrator and the others, while 개소리 is a blunt dismissal.
findings.replacement: Starting a campfire in the middle of enemy territory was bullshit that set everyone’s blood boiling, mine included. But one lunatic didn’t seem to mind.
findings.source: 적진 한가운데에서 캠프 파이어라니, 나를 포함한 다른 이들의 가슴에 불을 지르는 개소리였지만 어느 정신 나간 인간은 달랐다.

findings.defect: “Pest” suggests nuisance rather than harm, weakening the reason given for killing them.
findings.rationale: 해로운 describes birds that cause harm, not merely birds that are bothersome.

findings.defect: “Thump” suggests a blunt impact; 푹 marks something plunging into the monster immediately before it stops moving.
findings.rationale: The source’s sound conveys a penetrating blow, not a thud.

findings.current: The watchful eyes and the pursuers would catch up soon.
findings.defect: The draft makes the watching eyes themselves something that will catch up, though surveillance is already in place.
findings.rationale: The preceding discovery establishes the watching eyes as present; the approaching threat is the pursuers.
findings.replacement: Eyes were already watching us, and pursuers would soon be on our heels.

summary: The draft preserves the scene’s main events, but misplaces Ma Sanbao’s mask, omits Hak Woo’s epithet, and changes the sound of the final killing blow.
